what: get_call_run called with the argument name Ringdown used to send, call_id
source: observed against the live MCP endpoint on 2026-08-20, against a call placed over REST. Identifiers, phone numbers and spoken names are synthetic; the shape and every field that carries a finding are as observed.
unobserved: nothing elided; this is the whole JSON-RPC response, down to the call id the tool quoted back inside the validation error, which is synthetic here
why_it_matters: the tool takes run_id and rejects call_id outright, so the request Ringdown sent could never have been answered. It arrives as HTTP 200 with result.isError true and no JSON-RPC error key, so a parser that only looks for an error envelope reads it as a successful result
